name: FPC
fix_description: In burnLpToken, do not directly transfer tokens out of the LP pair via _update and then call sync(). This allows attackers to repeatedly trigger the burn mechanism to drain the pair. Fix: add per-block rate limit, or remove direct pair balance manipulation and use a proper buyback-and-burn via swap instead.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a multi-step exploit involving a flash loan, a Pancake pair callback swap flow, and understanding how a fee-on-transfer/burn token breaks AMM accounting to enable selling at an inflated price. The PoC is still relatively short and direct, but it requires protocol-specific DeFi knowledge beyond a simple access control or basic reentrancy bug.
